# rwa CLI

CLI for trading tokenized stocks & ETFs (Ondo Global Markets) on Solana via Jupiter.
264 tokens: TSLA, AAPL, NVDA, SPY, QQQ, and more.

## Install

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/outputlayer/rwa_cli --bin rwa
```

Or via install script:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/outputlayer/rwa_cli/main/install.sh | sh
```

## Error handling

On failure, commands exit with non-zero code. With `--json`, errors return `{"status":"error","error":"<message>"}` on stdout.

## Critical rules

- NEVER run rwa commands in parallel — Jupiter API rejects concurrent requests from the same wallet
- Run commands one at a time, sequentially: `rwa gm buy TSLA 100 -y && sleep 3 && rwa gm buy AAPL 100 -y`
- Always use `--json` flag for machine-readable output
- Always use `-y` flag for buy/sell to skip confirmation
- CLI auto-retries swap errors (max 2 retries). Do NOT retry manually after a swap error
- `send` transfers tokens to another wallet; `sell` swaps tokens for USDC — they are different commands
- Quote requires amount: `rwa --json gm quote <SYMBOL> <AMOUNT>`

## Commands

### Market info
- `rwa --json gm hours` — Current trading session + tradable token count
- `rwa --json gm hours --tradable` — List all tokens tradable in current session
- `rwa --json gm list` — All 264 tokens with tradable status
- `rwa --json gm list --search <keyword>` — Search tokens by name/symbol/sector

### Trading
- `rwa --json gm quote <SYM> <AMT>` — Swap quote (buy direction)
- `rwa --json gm quote <SYM> <AMT> --sell` — Swap quote (sell direction)
- `rwa --json gm buy <SYM> <AMT> -y` — Buy token with USDC
- `rwa --json gm buy <SYM> <AMT> -y --slippage 50` — Buy with max 0.5% slippage
- `rwa --json gm sell <SYM> <AMT> -y` — Sell token for USDC (exact number, `50%`, or `all`)
- `rwa --json gm close-all -y` — Sell ALL positions sequentially
- `rwa --json gm close-all <PCT>% -y` — Sell percentage of every position (e.g. `50%`)

### Portfolio & history
- `rwa --json gm portfolio` — Holdings, allocation, 24h change
- `rwa --json gm portfolio <WALLET>` — View any wallet's holdings
- `rwa --json gm history <SYM>` — Price history (default 1D)
- `rwa --json gm history <SYM> -r 1W` — Price history with range (1D/1W/1M/3M/1Y/ALL)

### Transfers
- `rwa --json gm send SOL <AMT> <TO> -y` — Send SOL
- `rwa --json gm send USDC <AMT> <TO> -y` — Send USDC
- `rwa --json gm send <TOKEN> <AMT> <TO> -y` — Send any token

### Maintenance
- `rwa --json gm reclaim` — Close empty token accounts, reclaim SOL rent
- `rwa --json gm reclaim --token <SYM>` — Reclaim only for a specific token

### Wallet
- `rwa keys generate` — Create new wallet
- `rwa keys import --seed-phrase "word1 word2 ..."` — Import from mnemonic
- `rwa keys show` — Show address + key file path

## Amount formats

- Exact: `100` (100 USDC or 100 tokens)
- Percentage: `50%` (half of balance)
- All: `all` (entire balance)

## Token symbols

Both `TSLA` and `TSLAon` formats accepted — resolved automatically.

## Trading sessions (ET)

- Pre-Market: 4:00 AM – 9:29 AM
- Regular: 9:30 AM – 3:59 PM
- Post-Market: 4:00 PM – 7:59 PM
- Overnight: 8:00 PM – 3:59 AM
- Closed: Fri 8 PM – Sun 8 PM

Not all tokens are tradable in every session. Use `list` or `hours --tradable` to check.

## Flags

- `--json` — Machine-readable JSON output on any command
- `-y` — Skip confirmation on buy/sell/send
- `--slippage <BPS>` — Max slippage in basis points (e.g. 50 = 0.5%). Default: 100 (1%)
- `--rpc-url <URL>` — Custom Solana RPC (or set `RWA_RPC_URL` env var)

## Slippage protection

- Default slippage: 1% (100 bps) sent to Jupiter when `--slippage` not specified
- Retry on high slippage: if quote shows >1% slippage, retries up to 3× with fresh quotes
- Hard block: swaps with >3% slippage are blocked entirely (even with `--slippage` flag)
- Jupiter Ultra uses RFQ (Request For Quote) — market makers decide whether to fill
- Small sells (<$1.50) are often rejected by MM or have extreme slippage

## Close-all behavior

- Positions < $1.50 are skipped automatically (market makers reject small swaps)
- Skipped tokens reported in JSON output with reason
- Sequential execution with 3s delay between swaps

## Gasless swaps

Jupiter handles gas fees — users do NOT need SOL for buy/sell. SOL still needed for `send` and ATA rent.

## Error recovery

- "Solana RPC unavailable" → wait 5 seconds, retry. After 3 failures, set `RWA_RPC_URL`
- "No swap route found" / "HTTP 400" → likely parallel execution. Run sequentially
- "HTTP 429" → rate limited. Wait 5s, retry
- Swap errors are auto-retried (max 2 retries with fresh orders)
